image_sampling: within original classes; common indices for all five pairs
crossed_sampling: same images plus five resampled seed pairs; independent SeedSequence children
duplicate_cluster_rule: all same-test exact-pixel IDs in one cluster; unmatched singleton; whole-cluster resampling with row-weighted mean
train_test_exclusion_rule: exclude every official-test ID whose existing pixel-audit group has an assigned train row; same exclusions for every method and seed; full official test primary
Brier: sum over classes, no class division
McNemar: exact binomial per model pair and seed; Holm over all10
